title: 🏨 Stay & Accommodation Near Hospitals
h1: Comfortable & Affordable Stay Options for International Patients
intro: We provide safe, hygienic, and affordable stay options for patients and their families — ensuring peace of mind during treatment and recovery.

sections.heading: 🛏️ Accommodation Options We Provide
points: Guest Houses & Service Apartments – Budget-friendly, home-like stay with kitchen facilities
3-Star & 4-Star Hotels – Comfortable rooms with patient-friendly amenities
Luxury Hotels – For families seeking premium comfort & services
Hospital Guest Rooms – In-campus stay for maximum convenience
Long-Term Rentals – Affordable serviced flats for recovery periods

sections.heading: 🌍 Why Patients Prefer Our Stay Services
points: Walking distance or short drive from top hospitals
Multilingual staff support for international guests
Special meal plans (Halal, vegetarian & diabetic diets)
Affordable pricing compared to hotels booked directly

sections.heading: 🩺 Extra Support for Patients
points: In-room nursing support available on request
Dietician-approved meals for patients under treatment
